verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity documents many cap table reports exportable to Excel, plus an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table, which is an open, portable standard. Excel pro formas with formulas and documented help moving to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley) further support portability. Missing for 10: explicit export of the full transaction history (transfers, repurchases, conversions, terminations) to CSV/Excel, confirmation that exports are available at any time on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
